title: Work table: prevent sorted header text overflowing fixed narrow columns
outcome: Check and correct sorted header layout at the Work table's minimum width while preserving stable column widths across virtual windows.
acceptance: At the minimum table width, sorting Priority, Lifecycle and Availability leaves each header and its sort indicator readable without overlapping the next column.
A targeted layout witness discriminates the offending header/indicator overflow and the corrected behavior while column allocation remains independent of mounted rows.
